title: Verifiable Docs By NFTVerse
tagline: A white-label solution for universities, schools, and organizations to issue and verify certificates
description:
Forgery of documents is a growing problem and demands the utmost attention. The fraudulent reproduction of certificates has increased significantly in recent years, becoming a menace for all the stakeholders. It is not only employers or universities who are duped by fake certificates but also students who are cheated by them.

With our solution, organisations can issue certificates on blockchain without getting into techicalities. Our white label solution can be integrated right into their existing CRM , websites or apps.
